description: Schema for interest-type entities: relationship-type definitions that also carry applied/not-applied badge UX. A concrete interest type (for example actionable, blocked, assigned-to, or not-interesting) declares its participant roles (a target entity and, for user-scoped interests, a user, and optionally a view) and the badge text shown when the interest is applied or not applied.

applied.description: Badge UX shown when the interest is applied to an entity.

notApplied.description: Badge UX shown when the interest is not applied (the toggle-off state).

display-entity-types.description: The entity types that this interest type is visible on globally. If absent, it is visible on every entity type. If empty, it is visible only on entity types that list this interest in their interest-types.

target-participant.description: The name of the participant property on the interest relationship that references the badged entity.

applies-to.description: Scope-participant descriptors that bind participants of the interest relationship to the current session's identities. Each entry names a participant on the relationship and the session value the participant must equal for the interest to apply.

participant-property-name.description: The name of the participant property on the interest relationship whose value must match the session identity.

entity-types.description: Optional constraint on the entity types allowed for this scope participant.

session-value.description: Which session identity this scope participant must equal for the interest to be considered applied to the current session.

indicator.description: Short glyph/label shown on the badge for this state.

actionText.description: Label for the action that transitions to this state.
